note: Family campground on the lower slopes of Pilot Mountain (Mountain Section), sites scattered among oaks and hickories; gravel back-ins, only some of which take RVs - check each site's length on ReserveAmerica. --Claude
summary: Confirmed no hookups or dump station, drinking water, two bathhouses with hot showers, 42 sites, ReserveAmerica booking. Changed season (year_round false) to March 15 - November 30 explicitly. Added max 38 ft (15 sites list a length, 25-38 ft), all back-in, 6-month window, holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days. Fees ($30 incl. $3 reservation fee) stand. Derived fcfs after_cutoff left (pages silent). Note trimmed of field facts.
